mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 63 degrees with overcast skies near Fireman's Park. We are currently in a first quarter moon phase.

The city has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, a long-term guide for future growth that includes strategies for housing, transportation, and economic development based on community feedback. Additionally, you can stay up to date on all projects and programs by subscribing to the digital city newsletter.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus for trivia night. Tomorrow, check out live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival kicks off this Friday.
In noteworthy calls for service, on September 5, an officer located multiple vehicles with a slice of cheese on their windshields in what appears to be a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a scheduled remodel, so we do not have a flavor of the day to report at this time.
